sections.Profile:
"Super Straight," produced by Sonic (Segasa) in May 1977, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a playing card and poker theme. This four-player game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, seven standup targets, and a unique spinning target.

- Manufacturer: Segasa
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Poker, Gambling, Card games, Original Theme, 1970s, Single level playfield
